Frozen canonical-like domain and one-reference coverage gate — 2026-10-08

PHRF-11 remains review. Experimental Cascade34 envelope: positive-component modes 4–6 s, undershoot/positive rate ratio .4–.6, area ratio .1–.3, 96-second support, eight fixed reference centers {.25,.75}^3 in normalized chart coordinates. SPM component modes 5/15 s and area ratio 1/6 motivate the anchor only; this is neither an SPM replica nor a calibrated physiological prior. Observed shape-probe FWHM is 6.065–9.985 s and trough latency 16.803–32.756 s. A deterministic coordinate-only nearest-reference router performs one candidate readout, three inverse applications, one correction and no exact fallback. Exact prepared and original-design QR solves are explicitly diagnostic comparators.

N=30 fresh primary coverage is 64/64. N=300 fresh coverage is 232/256 (90.625%), below required 95% (244/256); p95 corrected/original relative error .00115994 vs target .001. Boundary coverage is 16/27 and 2/27; noise-ratio-1 paired sensitivity is 31/32 and 52/64. All 566 exact prepared solves meet the original-observation amplitude target; N=300 fresh exact p95 is .000148795. The rank-8 representation and 96-second support are adequate for these sampled comparisons; corrected-reference approximation remains the numeric failure. Uniform absolute omitted tail-mass upper bound .00036876633813 does not certify coefficient or derivative error. Conditional ScenarioResult passes at N=30 and fails at N=300; both production scenarios remain Fail.

Next: introduce an explicit <=8-point reference bank independent of the regular decoder grid, choose anisotropic placement using separate development data and freeze before a new confirmation cohort. Post-hoc failures cluster in logKappaP distance (.229 mean vs .125 overall); other axes do not show that separation. This suggests a placement experiment, not a proven remedy. Separately audit/compact or compute on demand the actual derivative-reference arrays with full scratch and work accounting. Recheck fresh accuracy and N=1200 memory before a throughput sweep. Keep the domain scientifically provisional; original-equation certification within the work allowance and decoder/scientific calibration remain open.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-domain-gate-20261008/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 61029ed3. Protocol SHA256 29fc8e066b28d3d15cf1879868b7096555e059e318d93d868f849cdc2c586aa3 was frozen before measurement; no post-result retuning. All 566 attempted outcomes and 40 source/artifact hashes verify. New gate, neighborhood and existing public-fixture regressions pass on JVM and Scala.js: 9 tests each, no compiler warnings (existing multiple-main discovery message only). Changes are test support/evidence only; production defaults, accuracy/work budgets and Gale pin 62c0aeb3 unchanged. No ScalaFIM publication or merge.

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Reference neighborhoods and original-observation certification — 2026-10-08

PHRF-11 remains review; CertifiedOriginalEquations still refuses. The continuous original Cascade34 impulse observation adapter now encloses chart conversion, Erlang HRFs over all observed lags, exact-input sample/event times, AR(1) whitening, lambda=1 condition-centered penalty, normal equations and RHS. Gale validates a prepared reference inverse candidate with ||I-MG||inf<1, returning component and cancellation-aware signed-query bounds. Twelve of sixteen N=30 point attempts at radii 0/.001/.01 certify below the amplitude target; four at .1 refuse. One 96-second point has signed-query bound 3.98341e-7, versus observed 3.30865e-7, below the separate exploratory 1e-6 target. Twelve small boxes certify uniform conditioning, not uniform readout accuracy; four larger boxes refuse. Dense O(n^3) validation is charged diagnostic work outside the production single-extra-inverse allowance. This is useful original-model point certification, not production admission or a general family/drive/noise certificate.

The audit also found and fixed NodeGrid endpoint interpolation rounding beyond the chart; portable grid tests and existing recovery checks pass. Next: specify a viable domain/reference bank and derive a charged production certificate, keeping explicit refusals.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-neighborhoods-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 101c5ab6; hashes verified. Gale generic outward exponential and validated reference-system bounds are in 62c0aeb3374557874a17f870c9ae05e3290c21cf (https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/24, merged); ScalaFIM pins that topic revision without unrelated optimizer additions. Full fit tests pass: 707 JVM / 649 Scala.js; new observation/neighborhood laws, N=1200 integration, all 80 recovery reference cases with unchanged tolerances, and targeted comparison tests pass on both platforms. scalafimCompileAll passes without compiler warnings. Numerical/scientific/production qualification remain distinct. No ScalaFIM merge or publication.

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Residual admission and envelope-gradient follow-through — 2026-10-07

PHRF-11 remains review, not certified. Added explicit PreparedBasisResidualAtMost admission in native normal-equation coordinates and per-voxel ReadoutRefused outcomes that preserve accepted decoder state and charged work, without aborting neighboring outputs or exact fallback. The gated response map refuses an unconditional adjoint. This is empirical residual admission, not a coefficient-error bound. CertifiedOriginalEquations still refuses.

The new finite observation audit uses existing Gale outward arithmetic/ValidatedSvd at four fixed Cascade34 shapes. Finite rounded-array coefficient/query bounds enclose independent QR discrepancies but are very loose (exact 48-second coefficient bound up to 16.74, versus observed maximum-entry discrepancy 0.009963). Family evaluation, convolution, whitening, continuous-time integration and uniform reference neighborhoods are outside that enclosure. Dense per-shape SVD is charged diagnostic work, not inserted into the corrected fast path. Next: complete observation enclosures and a useful admitted neighborhood within the declared work budget; no tolerance change or silent exact fallback.

Validation: full fit 706 JVM / 648 Scala.js tests pass. All 80 recovery reference cases preserve the prior energy/shape/admission tolerances on both platforms; no bitwise trajectory identity is claimed. The six targeted law suites pass on both platforms (18 JS tests; JVM runs include final two-test horizon suite). Comparison: 466 JVM passed / 10 skipped, 17 targeted Scala.js tests passed. Compiler warning-clean; existing multiple-main discovery message only. No hosted CI, merge or publication. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-readout-bounds-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, base e1d67dfb; source/artifact hashes verified. Scientific and epic qualification remain open.

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-11 remains review, not certified. The new four-shape, 60-trial audit has 24 data/voxel cases in two readout modes. ExactShape agrees with same-basis augmented QR to 3.884e-13; corrected eight-corner readout differs by up to 2.223 trial-amplitude units. ExactShape differs from the full-observation original-family trial solve by up to 0.00889. A sampled observed-design tail discrepancy reaches 3.485%, versus 0.000558% within-horizon basis error at that shape. These are exploratory counterexamples, not uniform bounds.

Pinned Gale already supplies ValidatedSvd/MatrixEnclosure and outward arithmetic; this audit executes finite-array spectral validation with positive lower bounds. Missing work is a complete family/convolution/whitening/tail enclosure and reference-neighborhood conditioning/error bound within the declared corrected-readout budget. Public CertifiedOriginalEquations still refuses. Preserve exact axis/normalization/query binding and charged work; do not replace this with a tolerance change or hidden exact fallback.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.

Retained prior scope and acceptance

Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Native decoded ExactShape/PreparedBasisResidual ML outputs are on main, with same-worker readout and stable residual-plus-penalty energy. Original-family CertifiedOriginalEquations remains a refusal; prepared-basis residual and conditional output are narrower claims. ExactShape is charged work, not the originally required bounded corrected approximation.

Fresh context: Yes: partial engineering; certificate gap.

Next action: Audit the remaining bounded approximation/original-family error-envelope certificate requirements against current sources and admitted Gale primitives. Preserve signed axes, nuisance recovery, query cancellation, work accounting and unavailable adaptive uncertainty. Do not close from the green fit suites alone.

Evidence: docs/verification/profile-ml-public-output-2026-09-30.md; docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Roadmap refinement 2026-09-13 (authoritative scope): TrialBanded is required. FiniteState acceptance below applies only if the new complete B0 decision in PHRF-33 activates PHRF-10.

Concrete integration guidance:
1. Accept the actual decoded theta from PHRF-29. PreparedNode readout and ExactShape at hard-coded generating coordinates are fixed-shape controls, not final adaptive readout.
2. Final condition/trial amplitudes, nuisance coefficients and signed queries must reference one selected shape, normalization, exact axis identities, rank/estimability and refusal status. Do not equate axes by length. Normalize at readout under the existing amplitude/penalty-unit contract.
3. Expose an explicit bounded approximate/corrected readout and an opt-in exact-shape mode. Implement/count the declared directional solve and at most one second-order correction; certify against original equations or include all basis/interpolation/tail terms with declared conditioning/error bounds. An exact factor is an explicit charged option, not a fallback hidden behind PreparedNode.
4. Add direct signed-query evaluation without mandatory N-vector output, with independent dense query oracles, near-cancellation absolute errors, normalization/sign/axis metamorphisms and truthful Float32 conversion audits. Solving/interpolation/basis error and Float32 conversion are separate receipts.
5. Assemble the requested criterion consistently throughout search and readout. PenalizedProfile uses E; TrialRandomEffectsML also requires constrained log|K| and its correct shape derivatives (or an explicit supported scoring/refinement contract). Reuse CriterionJet and test ML energy/gradient/Hessian against dense covariance finite differences. The current scalar logDetAt result is not an ML determinant jet; refuse unsupported ML selection rather than omitting it.
6. Independent same-model dense tests on both platforms must cover off-node decoded shapes, all signed outputs and nuisance recovery, singleton/unequal/coincident conditions, lambda extremes and AR/run boundaries. Verify conditional linearity/adjoint only with shape frozen and maintain the distinct adaptive contract.
7. Publish output/certification work receipts for PHRF-33. Full throughput/crossover and scientific qualification remain separate downstream gates.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Owner: fit/profile; trial implementations of the common output contract introduced by PHRF-19/22.
Acceptance:
- Recover signed trial amplitudes and arithmetic means at prepared shapes against independent original penalized equations for TrialBanded and FiniteState; preserve all trial identities and rank/estimability diagnostics.
- At decoded shapes use directional first-order solve then one fixed second-order residual correction including nuisance coefficients; show local cubic error under admitted conditioning/smoothness. Count the reference solve and scoring derivative solves too.
- Certify original normal equations or include complete interpolation/tail error; eta<1 bounds and empirical/certified scope are explicit. At most one additional reference inverse application for residual certification.
- Extend signed queries directly via Q M beta + alpha (X Q')'q, without mandatory full trial-amplitude output. Verify independent direct-query parity and per-query absolute/scaled error, including cancellations. Count any remaining O(N) scratch/certification visits honestly.
- Separate forward/adjoint tests precede fused backward filters. Shared conditional readout APIs distinguish adaptive estimates from response-independent LSS TrialReadout and conditional transpose from adaptive derivative.
- JVM+JS laws for both backends, query output, nuisance recovery, streaming and continuous/readout refusal.
Performance: no N*d*V derivative fields or retained amplitude blocks; one correction maximum; no per-voxel covariance preparation. Final-shape readout occurs only after selection unless internal trial scoring mathematically requires coefficients.
